preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(row == '.' or row == 'X' for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '.' (unmarked) or 'X' (marked).

preconditions.expression: all(grid[0][j] == '.' and grid[n-1][j] == '.' for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: No marked cells are adjacent to the top or bottom edge of the grid.

preconditions.expression: all(grid[i][0] == '.' and grid[i][m-1] == '.' for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: No marked cells are adjacent to the left or right edge of the grid.

postconditions.description: The output starts with 'YES' if a suitable grid exists, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == (all(cell in {1, 4} for row in grid for cell in row if cell != 'X'))
postconditions.description: If a suitable grid exists, all unmarked cells contain either 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') == (all(sum(grid[i+di][j+dj] for di, dj in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)] if 0 <= i+di < n and 0 <= j+dj < m and grid[i+di][j+dj] != 'X') % 5 == 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X'))
postconditions.description: If a suitable grid exists, each marked cell contains a sum of adjacent unmarked cells that is a multiple of 5.
